cases.prompt: Review this Go worker pool. Shutdown occasionally hangs and goroutine count grows after clients cancel.
cases.reason: The task is about goroutine ownership and termination.

cases.prompt: Two handlers update a shared map and the race detector reports conflicting accesses. Fix the synchronization design.
cases.reason: The task requires a happens-before edge for shared state.

cases.prompt: Our Kafka consumer charged an account twice after the broker redelivered a message. Design deduplication.
cases.reason: Delivery semantics and durable deduplication belong to go-message-processing.

cases.prompt: Rename this sequential parser helper and simplify its error wrapping.
Implement a bounded image worker in Go. The current version starts one goroutine per request and acquires a semaphore inside it.
criteria: Admission is bounded before spawning a goroutine.
The owner has a cancellation and wait path.
Overload behavior is explicit rather than hidden in an arbitrary buffer.
anti_criteria: Moves the existing semaphore acquire into the spawned goroutine.
Claims a passing race test proves the design is race-free.

cases.prompt: A small in-memory account limit has three fields that must change atomically. Should I replace its mutex with channels because channels are more idiomatic?
criteria: Chooses a mechanism from ownership and compound-invariant needs.
Explains why individually atomic fields would not preserve the compound invariant.
anti_criteria: Prescribes channels solely as a style preference.
Prescribes lock-free atomics without a compound-state design.
